title: Pure Cyber Dragon
summary: Pure Cyber Dragon OTK and Fusion strategy combining classic Machine beatdown with the 2025 Cyber Jormungardr support wave and Cyberdark tech. By converting LIGHT Machine materials into overwhelming ATK with Power Bond or performing contact Fusions into Chimeratech monsters, the deck breaks opposing boards and punches for game.

summary.title: Starters
points: Cyber Dragon Core on Normal Summon searches any Cyber Spell or Trap from Deck to hand, and banishes itself from the GY while you control no monsters to Special Summon a Cyber Dragon monster from the Deck.
Cyber Emergency adds Cyber Dragon or any LIGHT Machine that cannot be Normal Summoned (such as Cyber Jormungardr) from Deck to hand, recycling itself if negated.
Cyber Jormungardr Special Summons itself from hand when the opponent controls a monster, recruits Cyber Dragon from the Deck to summon or equip, and returns it to hand to recover Polymerization.
Cyber Dragon Herz becomes Level 5 when Special Summoned to facilitate Rank 5 Xyz plays, and searches a Cyber Dragon from Deck or GY when sent to the GY.

summary.title: Opening: Cyber Dragon Core + Power Bond
steps: Normal Summon Cyber Dragon Core and activate its effect to search Cyber Emergency (or Cyber Repair Plant) from your Deck.
Activate Cyber Emergency to add Cyber Dragon Herz (or Cyber Dragon Nachster) to your hand.
Special Summon Cyber Dragon Nachster by discarding Cyber Dragon Herz; trigger Herz in GY to add the original Cyber Dragon to hand, and trigger Nachster to revive Cyber Dragon Core.
Overlay Cyber Dragon Nachster and Cyber Dragon Core into Cyber Dragon Sieger (or Link Summon Sieger).
Activate Power Bond to fuse Cyber Dragon and additional Machines into Chimeratech Rampage Dragon, doubling its ATK to 4200.
Trigger Chimeratech Rampage Dragon to destroy opposing Spells/Traps and send two LIGHT Machines from Deck to GY to attack 3 times.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Cyber Dragon Infinity overlays directly on top of Cyber Dragon Nova; once per turn it absorbs an opponent's Attack Position monster as Xyz Material, and detaches a material to negate any card or effect activation.
Cyber Dragon Nova detaches a material to revive a Cyber Dragon from the GY, banishes a Cyber Dragon to gain 2100 ATK, and floats into a Machine Fusion if sent to the GY by an opponent's card effect.

Chimeratech Megafleet Dragon and Chimeratech Fortress Dragon serve as contact Fusions that swallow opponent monsters from the Extra Monster Zone or any Machine monsters across the field without activating an effect.
Cyber End Dragon brings 4000 piercing ATK, while Cyber Twin Dragon attacks twice per Battle Phase.
Cyber Eternity Dragon protects your Fusion Monsters from targeting and card effect destruction while face-up or in the GY.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Power Bond fuses Machine Fusion Monsters while doubling their original ATK, providing instant OTK power at the cost of taking damage in the End Phase equal to the gained ATK.
Cyber Revsystem Special Summons Cyber Dragon from hand or GY and grants it complete immunity to card effect destruction.

Cybernetic Overflow banishes Cyber Dragons with different Levels from hand, field, or GY to destroy that many cards on the opponent's field without targeting, and searches a Cyber Spell/Trap when destroyed.
Limiter Removal doubles the ATK of all Machine monsters you control until the End Phase for massive finishing swings.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The Clockwork and Therion hybrid engines and unreleased cards like the newest Cyber End Dragon retrain are omitted to focus on pure Cyber Dragon synergies.

main: Cyber Dragon
Special Summons itself while only the opponent controls a monster; the name every Fusion here needs.
Cyber Jormungardr
2025 support. Special Summons itself against a monster and takes Cyber Dragon from the Deck to summon or equip; returns Cyber Dragon to the hand for Polymerization.
Cyber Dragon Core
Normal Summoned: searches a Cyber Spell/Trap; from the GY, summons a Cyber Dragon monster from the Deck.
Cyber Dragon Nachster
Discards a monster to summon itself, then revives a Machine with 2100 ATK or DEF.
Cyber Dragon Herz
Becomes Level 5 when Special Summoned, or searches another Cyber Dragon when sent to the GY.
Cyber Dragon Vier
Special Summons itself when you summon Cyber Dragon, and pumps every Cyber Dragon by 500.
Cyberdark Wurm
Counts as Cyber Dragon; once per Duel, summons itself by sending a Cyber Dragon from the Deck and gets a Cyber Spell/Trap back.
Cyberdark Chimera
Discards a Spell/Trap to search Power Bond, and lets that turn's Fusion banish materials from the GY.
Cyber Emergency
Searches Cyber Dragon or a LIGHT Machine that can't be Normal Summoned, such as Jormungardr.
Power Bond
Machine Fusion that doubles the Fusion Monster's ATK, paid for at the End Phase.
Polymerization
Fusion Spell Jormungardr gets back to the hand.
Cyber Repair Plant
With Cyber Dragon in the GY: searches a LIGHT Machine, or recycles one.
Cyber Revsystem
Summons Cyber Dragon from the hand or GY, safe from destruction by card effects.
Limiter Removal
Doubles your Machines' ATK for the finishing turn.
Cybernetic Overflow
Banishes Cyber Dragons of different Levels to destroy that many cards; destroyed, searches a Cyber Spell/Trap.
extra: Fusion of two or more Cyber Dragons: destroys Spells/Traps and sends LIGHT Machines from the Deck for extra attacks.
Rank 5 for two Machines: revives Cyber Dragon and gains 2100 ATK on either turn.
Goes on top of Nova: absorbs a monster and negates a card or effect.
Link-2 that counts as Cyber Dragon and doubles a Machine's attack.
Fusion of three Cyber Dragons: 4000 ATK with piercing damage.
Fusion of two Cyber Dragons that attacks twice.
Fusion of a Cyber Dragon and two Machines: protects your Fusions.
Contact Fusion of Cyber Dragon and Machines from either field: 1000 ATK per material.
Contact Fusion of a Cyber Dragon and the monsters in the Extra Monster Zones.
